title: Beyond Dirichlet GRH: a source audit and a research transfer map

paper_level_reductions: One-sided transform criterion with positive leading real Laurent coefficients
new_solution_claims: No claim of novelty for known implications or extracted reductions.
No proof of S3 GRH, general Artin/Hecke GRH, Vandiver, BSD, or new universal K-group vanishing is supplied.

pdf_quality_assurance.review_note: All report pages reviewed in contact sheets; title, dense mathematics, diagram and final appendices also reviewed at larger scale.
pdf_quality_assurance.build_note: Built using installed TeX sources with a private format/font-map setup because system format indexes were absent. The bundled portable script targets a normally configured TeX installation and was syntax-checked.
